title: Did you know… the Red Sea did not part while Israel was panicking on the shore.
paragraphs: Did you know… the Red Sea did not part while Israel was panicking on the shore.

It parted when God said, “Tell the people of Israel to go forward.”
And Moses stretched out his hand in obedience.
Exodus 14:15–16.

That means the miracle was not permission to stay frozen.
It was God’s answer to faith in motion.

Fear said, “Stand here and die.”
Pharaoh said, “You have no way out.”
The sea said, “You can’t pass.”

And that is still how many of us miss Him.
We pray for open waters while refusing the first obedient step.
We want clarity before surrender.
We want safety before trust.
We want the whole path before we take one holy step forward.

Sometimes God does not split the sea before you move.
Sometimes He splits it because you moved at His word.

Not reckless movement.
Not flesh-driven hustle.
Obedience.

The same God who made a road through the sea made a cross through your sin.
Jesus did not wait for you to clean yourself up before making a way.
He moved first in mercy.
And now because of His grace, you can move forward in faith.

So take the step.
Pray anyway.
Forgive anyway.
Repent anyway.
Obey anyway.

The sea is not your master.
Jesus is.
